08:30 - Surgery: BRIDGES, Kirstie (Dr) (Clinical Practitioner Access Role) 
Problem: Biopsy of sentinel lymph node (XaF83)
Problem: Malignant tumour of breast (X78WM)
Problem: Invasive carcinoma of breast (Ya0ln) - lobular
Problem: Mastectomy of right breast (XacLJ)
History: Cancer care review and general catch up given recent events
Referred by me on 2ww earlier this year, confirmed breast cancer
Initially advised she could go on a trial and have tablets, lumpectomy, then tablets
Plan changed post MRI as tumour larger than suspected - had mastectomy July and planned radiotherapy POSS chemo also - awaiting plan from Onc - 14th Oct appt
Here with husband, supportive - goes to all appts etc
Had a chat about journey, inc issues
Main issue at the moment is medication induced menopausal hot flushing and sleep issues (also some joint pains etc)
Initially, found venlafaxine helpful but now not seeming to do anything
Asking about alternatives - discussed options inc gabapentin, pregab, clonidine etc
Also, needs emollient for scars - will issue
Plan: Doing well but still on 'conveyor belt'
Signed posted to Sue Young Cancer Support and will access MacMillan - esp for financial advice
Discussed trial of gabapentin, how to use, pros and cons etc - keen to give it a go
Med3 done and will update me post Onc review re chemo
To call as required for support

Gabapentin 300mg capsules - 84 capsule - Take one capsule once a day day one, one capsule twice a day on day two and then one three times daily - adjust according to symptom control, as discussed
